posts.name: Trajector
posts.cooked:
Some of the recent forum events seem like they are about amassing statistics in what I find to be a somewhat…impersonal manner. So I thought I’d start a challenge, and make it PERSONAL!

Here’s how it works: this thread will have one active challenge in it at a time, directed at a particular forumite. The challenge can be any situation or task completable in the Sentinels of the Multiverse card/video game. If you defeat a challenge, you post the next one! If you forfeit, the initiative reverts to the original challenger. Be sure to tell us your war stories.

Let’s do this in ask-a-forumite style, where we only issue challenges to people who have posted in this thread. But, to start us off, I’m just going to pick somebody who I think likely to participate:

Arcanist Lupus! I’m calling you out! Baron Blade is threatening Megalopolis with his most devious plan yet, after distracting all the world’s super teams to get them out of the way. Defeat Advanced Baron Blade, in Megalopolis, choosing only heroes who are not a member of any usual teams (Ra, KNYFE, etc).

posts.name: PeterCHayward
posts.cooked:
@Skippy: Here's a weird challenge I've been wanting someone to do for a while: Traitor Sentinels: The Traitor Sentinels Game


Choose 5 heroes and a villain/environment of your choice. At the start of the game, shuffle the heroes and pick one at random. That hero must spend their turns dealing as much damage to their team as they possibly can. The other heroes play as normal; they can attack that hero or ignore them, they can assist or resist him. That one hero, however, must treat the other members of the team as if they were the enemy (not mechanically; they still have to follow the rules of the game), and cannot deal ANY damage to the villain.

Report back once you win a game this way!
